title: Wonder Cat Kyuu-chan
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Hinata, a young office worker, takes in Kyuu-chan, an abandoned cat who walks on two legs and loves snacks, cuddles and bow ties. Full-color four-panel strips follow the two adjusting to life together and learning from each other.
life_message: Small daily kindnesses and caring for a vulnerable creature make an ordinary life warm and full.
